The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document. All parties, dates, agreement references, and structural details are correctly stated:

MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all key financial terms that are available in the source document. The source document is a joinder agreement that references but does not contain the detailed financial terms of the underlying credit facility (such as loan amounts, interest rates, maturity dates, etc.). The memo correctly identifies these as "N/A" since they are not present in the source document. All material terms that are actually contained in the joinder agreement have been properly captured, including:

- Party names and entity structures
- Date of the joinder agreement (June 7, 2022)
- Reference dates for underlying agreements
- Guarantee obligations (joint and several)
- Collateral/security interest provisions
- Administrative agent (JPMorgan Chase Bank)

The memo appropriately acknowledges the limitation that detailed credit facility terms are not available in this particular source document.
